# Platform adapter options

The keys of `[gateway.platforms.<platform>] options` for each first-party adapter of [`config.toml`](configuration.md). Unknown keys are rejected. An adapter plugin publishes its own schema (`prometheus gateway platforms`). Apply: `next_session` takes effect when the adapter next connects.

## Telegram

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.api_base_url` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | A self-hosted Bot API server (`http://127.0.0.1:8081`): bots may then download files up to 2048 MB instead of 20 MB. Log the bot out of the public server first (`prometheus gateway telegram logout`). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.command_menu.max_commands` | integer | `60` | 1 to 100 | `next_session` | Entries registered at most. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.command_menu.priority` | array of string | `[]` | any | `next_session` | Commands placed first (or last, or alone) whatever the cap. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.command_menu.priority_mode` | one of "prepend", "append", "replace" | `"prepend"` | `"prepend"`, `"append"`, `"replace"` | `next_session` | Where the priority entries go. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.dm_topics.enabled` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Each DM topic is its own session and the root DM is a lobby that accepts only commands (`/topic new\|list\|rename\|restore`). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.file_base_url` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The self-hosted server's file download base; unset: `<api_base_url>/file`. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.group_topics` | table | unset | any | `next_session` | Topics of forum groups, by chat id. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.ignore_root_dm` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Ignore ordinary messages in the root of a private chat (slash commands are still accepted). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.local_mode` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | The self-hosted server runs with `--local`: files are read from the absolute path it returns (the server's files must be readable here). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.mode` | one of "polling", "webhook" | `"polling"` | `"polling"`, `"webhook"` | `next_session` | How updates arrive: long polling, or webhook posts on the shared listener at `/p/<profile>/telegram/`. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.poll_timeout_secs` | integer | `30` | 1 to 50 | `next_session` | Seconds one long-poll `getUpdates` call waits for updates. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.rich_messages` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Send replies as Telegram rich messages (Bot API 10.1 `sendRichMessage`: the raw Markdown, up to 32768 characters), falling back to `MarkdownV2` when Telegram refuses one. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.setup_service_url` | string | `"https://setup.hermes-agent.nousresearch.com"` | any | `next_session` | The onboarding service Create with QR asks to create a bot (`POST <url>/v1/telegram/pairings`, then polls the pairing). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.slash_commands` | boolean | `true` | any | `next_session` | Register the gateway's commands and skills as the bot's command menu; `false` on a follower daemon sharing one bot. |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.webhook_public_url` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The public HTTPS URL Telegram posts updates to in webhook mode (it must reach `/p/<profile>/telegram/` on the shared listener). |
| `gateway.platforms.telegram.options.webhook_secret_secret` | string | unset | a secret name | `next_session` | The secret token Telegram sends with every webhook update (required in webhook mode). |

## Discord

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.auto_thread` | boolean | `true` | any | `next_session` | Answer each mention in a text channel in a new thread. |
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.free_response_auto_thread` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Also open threads in free-response channels. |
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.free_response_channels` | array of string | unset | any | `next_session` | Channels answered without a mention even when `require_mention` is on. |
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.no_thread_channels` | array of string | unset | any | `next_session` | Channels where answers always stay inline. |
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.require_mention` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Answer only messages that mention the bot in server channels (direct messages are always answered). |
| `gateway.platforms.discord.options.slash_commands` | boolean | `true` | any | `next_session` | Register the gateway's commands as application commands; `false` on a follower daemon sharing one application. |

## Slack

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.slack.options.app_token_secret` | string | unset | a secret name | `next_session` | The secret holding the Socket Mode app-level token. |
| `gateway.platforms.slack.options.reaction_trigger_target` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | Where a reaction-triggered turn answers: a channel id, or `channel:thread_ts`; unset answers beside the reacted message. |
| `gateway.platforms.slack.options.reaction_triggers` | boolean or array of string | unset | any | `next_session` | Reactions that start a turn (`reaction:added:<emoji>`, the reacted message as reply context): `false` none (reaction events are acknowledged and dropped), `true` any reaction on the bot's own messages, or a list of emoji names on any message. The reacting user passes the same authorization as a message author. |

## Email

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.address` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The mailbox address the agent answers as. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.authserv_id` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The receiving server whose `Authentication-Results` header is trusted (for example `mx.google.com`). |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.imap_host` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | IMAP server host. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.imap_port` | integer | `993` | 0 to 65535 | `next_session` | IMAP server port. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.imap_security` | one of "tls", "starttls", "plain" | unset | `"tls"`, `"starttls"`, `"plain"` | `next_session` | IMAP transport security. Unset: `tls`. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.poll_interval_secs` | integer | `15` | 1 to 3600 | `next_session` | Seconds between two IMAP polls. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.require_authenticated_sender` | boolean | `true` | any | `next_session` | Drop mail whose From domain the trusted `Authentication-Results` header does not authenticate. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.skip_attachments` | boolean | `false` | any | `next_session` | Skip attachment parts without decoding them. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.smtp_host` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | SMTP server host. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.smtp_port` | integer | `587` | 0 to 65535 | `next_session` | SMTP server port. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.smtp_security` | one of "tls", "starttls", "plain" | unset | `"tls"`, `"starttls"`, `"plain"` | `next_session` | SMTP transport security. Unset: `tls` on port 465, else `starttls`. |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.tls_verify` | boolean | `true` | any | `next_session` | Verify the servers' certificates (a WARN at every start when off for a non-loopback host). |
| `gateway.platforms.email.options.username` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The login name, when it is not the address. |

## Matrix

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.matrix.options.allowed_rooms` | array of string | unset | any | `next_session` | Rooms (internal `!` room ids, not `#` aliases) the bot reads; checked before any other gating. Two-member rooms (DMs) are exempt; empty reads every joined room. |
| `gateway.platforms.matrix.options.auto_join` | one of "authorized", "all", "none" | `"authorized"` | `"authorized"`, `"all"`, `"none"` | `next_session` | Which invites the bot accepts. |
| `gateway.platforms.matrix.options.homeserver` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The homeserver URL. |
| `gateway.platforms.matrix.options.session_scope` | one of "auto", "room", "thread" | `"auto"` | `"auto"`, `"room"`, `"thread"` | `next_session` | How a room maps onto sessions. |

| `gateway.platforms.whatsapp.options.bridge_url` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | A `WhatsApp` bridge already running (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>`). Unset: the adapter starts the managed bridge runtime itself. |
| `gateway.platforms.whatsapp.options.group_policy` | one of "pairing", "allowlist", "open" | `"pairing"` | `"pairing"`, `"allowlist"`, `"open"` | `next_session` | Which groups are admitted. |

## Webhook

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Apply | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gateway.platforms.webhook.options.github_api_url` | string | `"https://api.github.com"` | any | `next_session` | The GitHub REST API `deliver = "github_comment"` posts to (GitHub Enterprise: `https://<host>/api/v3`). |
| `gateway.platforms.webhook.options.public_url` | string | unset | any | `next_session` | The `https://` origin that reaches this daemon's HTTP listener from outside (a reverse proxy or tunnel; plain `http://` is refused). Required for MCP event subscriptions, which servers deliver to `<public_url>/p/<profile>/webhook/<route>`. |
